name: Gujarat
intro: The white salt desert of Kutch and its craft villages, Gir's Asiatic lions, Somnath and Dwarka, Harappan Dholavira and Lothal, the stepwells and Solanki temples of the north, UNESCO-listed old Ahmedabad and Champaner, and Gandhi's ashram.

trails.name: Kutch circuit
trails.note: White Rann, craft villages, Harappan ruins and a forgotten port.

trails.note: Dwarka, Somnath and the sacred hill of Girnar.

trails.note: Gujarat's great wildlife: lions, wild asses, blackbuck and flamingos.

trails.name: Old Ahmedabad

trails.name: Harappan Gujarat

trails.name: Modern Ahmedabad
trails.note: Kahn, Corbusier, Doshi and a living textile city.
